HACIENDA DE LUISANA RESORT & ESTATE
Property Management, Smart Lock (RFID + Mobile Key / ESP32) & Live Tracking System Flow
System Architectural Flowchart v2 — Unified Production Specification

GLOBAL CONVENTIONS (System Rules v2):
• G1 — No Dangling ENDs: Every terminal sets final status + releases held dates + notifies customer + writes Activity Log.
• G2 — Enforced Availability: System DB overlap check at submit and at approval (not eyeball-only).
• G3 — Money Last: Approve booking & KYC before payment collection; verified money touched only via Refund pipeline.
• G4 — 24h TTL: Any booking in a pending stage for 24 hours auto-expires (EXPIRED → release dates → notify).
• G5 — One Credential Pipeline: RFID card & BLE Mobile Key share the same verification checklist & offline cache.
• G6 — Consent-Gated Tracking: Guest GPS tracking requires active consent (RA 10173); auto-purges N days post checkout.
• G7 — Central DB Auditing: Every state change writes timestamp, operator, and entity payload to Central DB.

CENTRAL DATABASE & STORAGE (Firestore / Cloud DB)
• Users, Government ID / KYC Verification Records, Staff, Admins, Super Admin
• Accommodations, Availability Calendar, 24h Date Holds (TTL Engine)
• Bookings, Payments, Payment Proofs, Refunds, Security Deposits
• Smart Lock Credentials (RFID Cards/Tags, Mobile Key BLE Tokens, Status)
• ESP32 Hardware Controls, Access Logs, Offline Log Buffer, Lockout Events
• Guest Locations, Location History (Encrypted), Consent Records, Purge Logs
• Damage Reports, Evidence Media, Maintenance Tasks, Cleaning, Inspections
• Account Requests, Archived Accounts DB, Provisioning Logs, System Notifications

BOOKING STATUS LIFECYCLE STATE MACHINE:
Main Path:
PENDING → KYC SUBMITTED → APPROVED → PAYMENT PENDING →
PAYMENT VERIFIED → RESERVED → CHECKED-IN → STAYING →
CHECKED-OUT → COMPLETED

Terminal Branch States:
• REJECTED (Availability overlap or KYC failure; dates released)
• CANCELLED (Pre-payment or Host cancel; dates released)
• REFUNDED (Post-payment cancel; deposit + refund policy executed)
• EXPIRED (24h TTL timeout in any pending stage; dates released)

SYSTEM-WIDE ACTIVITY AUDIT TRAIL:
Every single mutation records: Timestamp, User ID, Role, IP Address, Action Performed, Entity, State Snapshot. Immutable write-once audit log.
